svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: How RAG Works — Live Query Example
Retrieval = find info · Augmented = add it to the prompt · Generation = LLM writes the answer
A · PREPARE KNOWLEDGE (done once, before any question)
B · ANSWER A LIVE QUESTION (every time a user asks)

g.text: 💬 “Supervised learning is ML where the model learns from labeled data.”

svg.text: Augmented prompt — what the LLM actually receives:

g.text: Instruction: Answer using only the context below. If it is not there, say you don't know.
Context: [#41] Supervised learning is a type of machine learning that uses labeled data.
Removed headers like “CSE-4101 · Page 7”, page numbers and extra spaces
Chunk #41 = “Supervised learning is a type of machine learning that uses labeled data.” (≈400 chunks total)
Chunk #41 → [0.20, -0.40, 0.77, …] (384 numbers that represent its meaning)
Saved row → id=41 | text | vector | source = lecture_week3.pdf, page 7 ✔ library ready
Step 6 · LIVE QUERY: a student asks
Question → [0.21, -0.38, 0.75, …] (SAME embedding model used for the chunks)
Compare question vector with all 400 stored vectors (cosine similarity)
k = 3 chunks returned → #41 (0.93), #12 (0.41), #77 (0.38); #41 carries the answer
Build one prompt = Instruction + retrieved Context + original Question (see panel above)
LLM (GPT / Claude / Llama) reads only this prompt → writes an answer grounded in chunk #41
Step 13 · Answer shown to the student
“Supervised learning is ML where the model learns from labeled data.” — source: lecture_week3.pdf p.7
